Trans World Radio FAQ

What frequency is Trans World Radio on?
In the B-26 season Trans World Radio is scheduled on 29 shortwave frequencies, including 6100, 6175, 7410, 7480, 9320, 9500 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9655 kHz (10:30 pm – 10:45 pm Eastern). For Europe: 7410 kHz (7:20 pm – 7:35 pm UTC+1).

What time is Trans World Radio on shortwave?
Trans World Radio is scheduled in 47 UTC time windows this season, from 00:30–01:00 UTC through 19:35–19:50 UTC. English broadcasts: 11:30–11:45 UTC; 00:30–01:00 UTC; 11:00–11:32 UTC; 14:45–14:46 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Trans World Radio in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9655 kHz (10:30 pm – 10:45 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Trans World Radio broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 9910 kHz at 11:30–11:45 UTC to Far East; 11925 kHz at 11:30–11:45 UTC to Far East; 12120 kHz at 00:30–01:00 UTC to Far East; 13700 kHz at 11:00–11:32 UTC to Far East; 15310 kHz at 11:30–11:45 UTC to Far East; plus 1 more.

Is Trans World Radio on the air right now?
As of Friday, November 13, 2026, 13:05 UTC, Trans World Radio is scheduled to be broadcasting on 11925 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
